title: Affine-space ambient adjunction
statement:
Let $N\geq1$ be an integer, let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $NA=0$, and let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], meaning one admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], on which $N$ is invertible. Let $d\in\mathbb N$ and let $p_d:\mathbf A^d_S\to S$ be the affine-space projection [def-sbc-affine-space]. Work on the small etale sites with the entire ordinary unbounded derived categories of constant-$A$ module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. The functor $p_d^*=p_d^{-1}$ is exact inverse image applied termwise to complexes [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Use the ordinary finite etale Tate sheaves [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist]
$$A_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{(\mathbf Z/N)_T}A_T,\qquad A_T(0)=A_T,\qquad A_T(d)=A_T(1)^{\otimes_{A_T}d}\quad(d>0),$$
where $\mu_{N,T}(U)=\{z\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)^\times:z^N=1\}$, and write $K(d)=K\otimes_A^LA_T(d)$ using the ordinary derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. Define ordinary etale compact supports by a compactification as in [def-amb-etale-compact-support], with the compactification-independent identification on these whole categories supplied by [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. There is an adjunction
$$Rp_{d!}:D((\mathbf A^d_S)_{\mathrm{et}},A)\ \rightleftarrows\ D(S_{\mathrm{et}},A):p_d^*(-)(d)[2d],\qquad Rp_{d!}\dashv p_d^*(-)(d)[2d].$$
In particular, the assertion imposes no boundedness or constructibility condition on either argument.

proof.text: Construct the explicit coordinate tower and its composite adjunction, using successive projective-line and open-immersion adjunctions.
Identify its left functor with ordinary compact supports, and its right functor with exact inverse image, finite Tate twist and shift.
Transport the tower adjunction across these two natural isomorphisms using Adjunction.ofNatIsoLeft and Adjunction.ofNatIsoRight.

proof_origin.place: Proof: explicit coordinate tower, compact-support comparison, tensor/shift comparison, and transport of the composite adjunction.

blueprint_update.statement:
For $p_d:\mathbf A^d_S\to S$, on the entire ordinary
derived categories of etale $A$-module sheaves,

$$
Rp_{d!}\dashv p_d^*(d)[2d].
$$

proof.text:
Let $j:\mathbf A^1_S\hookrightarrow\mathbf P^1_S$.
The definition in [def-amb-etale-compact-support]
is $Rp_{1!}=Rq_*j_!$. By
[thm-amb-p1-adjunction], [lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality],
its right adjoint is $j^*q^*(1)[2]=p_1^*(1)[2]$.
For $d=0$ the assertion is the identity adjunction.
The composition of compact-support functors is
[lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons]. For $d>0$, factor the affine-space projection into
$d$ successive affine-line projections. The right
adjoint of the composite is the reversed composite of
their right adjoints, by their Hom adjunction bijections.
The twists add by [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], giving
$p_d^*(d)[2d]$.
